steps.message: Merge the contents of Markor notes copy_cool_snake.txt, backup_sharp_yacht.txt and 2023_03_23_busy_penguin.txt (in the same order) into a new Markor note named HebXPVJP and save it. Add a new line between the content of each note.

Execute: adb shell "for f in 'copy_cool_snake.txt' 'backup_sharp_yacht.txt' '2023_03_23_busy_penguin.txt'; do echo '=== '"$f"' ==='; find /sdcard /storage/emulated/0 -type f -name \"$f\" 2>/dev/null; done"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "for f in 'copy_cool_snake.txt' 'backup_sharp_yacht.txt' '2023_03_23_busy_penguin.txt'; do echo '=== '"$f"' ==='; find /sdcard /storage/emulated/0 -type f -name \"$f\" 2>/dev/null; done""

steps.message: Execute: adb shell "for f in /storage/emulated/0/Documents/Markor/copy_cool_snake.txt /storage/emulated/0/Documents/Markor/backup_sharp_yacht.txt /storage/emulated/0/Documents/Markor/2023_03_23_busy_penguin.txt; do echo '===FILE===' $f; cat \"$f\"; echo; echo '===EOF_BYTE_HEX==='; tail -c 1 \"$f\" | od -An -tx1; done"
